items.headline: CVS Health Engages in Medicare Negotiations to Expand Pharmacist Roles and GLP-1 Access
items.summary: CVS Health is in discussions with Medicare to broaden the scope of pharmacist-led chronic disease management and improve patient access to high-cost GLP-1 medications.

items.headline: Narmi Expands Model Context Protocol Capabilities to Microsoft 365 Copilot
items.summary: Digital banking solutions provider Narmi has integrated its Model Context Protocol (MCP) capabilities into Microsoft 365 Copilot.

items.headline: Broadcom Expands Host Bus Adapter Support for Seagate SMR Technology
items.summary: Broadcom has added support for Seagate's Shingled Magnetic Recording (SMR) technology to its host bus adapter (HBA) product line to improve storage efficiency.

items.headline: Amazon Business Expands Business Prime Benefits for SMBs
items.summary: Amazon Business has introduced new collaborations with Intuit QuickBooks, CrowdStrike, and Gusto to provide small and medium-sized businesses with discounted access to essential operational tools.

items.headline: Reports of Potential NVIDIA Interest in Ambarella Acquisition
items.summary: Market reports suggest NVIDIA may be exploring an acquisition of Ambarella, a company specializing in low-power AI chips.

items.headline: BlackRock Canada Announces October Cash Distributions for iShares Premium Money Market ETF
items.summary: BlackRock Asset Management Canada Limited declared final cash distributions for the iShares Premium Money Market ETF for October 2026.

items.headline: Verosoft Launches AI Orchestration Platform Built on Microsoft Dynamics 365
items.summary: Industrial technology company Verosoft has announced the general availability of Verovia, an AI orchestration platform built on Microsoft Dynamics 365.

items.headline: Semperis Expands Security Collaboration with Microsoft
items.summary: Semperis has deepened its security collaboration with Microsoft by integrating its Lightning Platform with Microsoft Sentinel and Security Copilot.

items.headline: Amazon Business to Host Annual 'Reshape 2026' Conference
items.summary: Amazon Business is set to hold its fifth annual 'Reshape' conference in Nashville, Tennessee, focusing on procurement strategy and AI implementation.

items.headline: Financial Institutions Form $63 Billion Financing Vehicle for Broadcom AI Infrastructure
items.summary: A coalition of banks and Blackstone is establishing a $63 billion special purpose vehicle to purchase Broadcom AI accelerators and networking solutions for lease to Anthropic.

items.headline: Cathie Wood Buys Joby, Archer Aviation as Air Taxi Bets Grow, Ark Pounces on Nu Holdings Stock After Lula’s Brazil Win
items.summary: Cathie Wood’s Ark Invest added Nu Holdings, Joby and Circle while trimming ARKB, Taiwan Semiconductor and AMD on Monday.

items.headline: Chuck Schumer Says Americans Paid ‘Billions More for Gas’ as Trump Profited From Oil Stocks; White House Insists Low Prices Are ‘Priority’
items.summary: Chuck Schumer accused Donald Trump of profiting from oil and gas stocks while Americans pay more for gas, vowing to hold him accountable.

items.headline: Marjorie Taylor Greene Says Voters Will Send Republicans a ‘Powerful Message’ in Midterms: ‘Not Confident They Will Learn’
items.summary: Marjorie Taylor Greene warned Republicans of midterm losses, accusing them of blindly backing Trump despite his 33% approval rating.

items.headline: General Dynamics Awarded $135.9 Million Army Contract Modification
items.summary: General Dynamics has received a $135.9 million contract modification from the U.S. Army to provide retrofit kits for the Stryker vehicle fleet.

items.headline: Scotiabank Adjusts Newmont Price Target to $148
items.summary: Scotiabank has updated its price target for Newmont Corporation to $148.

items.headline: Moody's Ratings Upgrades Danaos Corporation's Senior Unsecured Notes and Revises Outlook to Positive
items.summary: Moody's Ratings changed the outlook on Danaos Corporation's Ba1 Corporate Family Rating to positive from stable and upgraded its senior unsecured notes to Ba1 from Ba2.

items.headline: Moody's Ratings Announces Rating Actions on CLO Notes
items.summary: Moody's Ratings issued rating confirmations for various classes of notes issued by collateralized loan obligation (CLO) entities, including Madison Park Funding and Carlyle US CLO.

items.headline: EOG Resources Sets Q3 2026 Earnings Date and Reaffirms Production Targets
items.summary: EOG Resources is scheduled to report its third-quarter 2026 financial results on November 5, 2026, while maintaining its annual production growth and capital expenditure guidance.

items.headline: Nasdaq, Inc. Announces Board of Directors Changes
items.summary: Nasdaq, Inc. has appointed Börje Ekholm to its Board of Directors, effective November 1, 2026, while Holden Spaht has announced his resignation from the Board, effective December 31, 2026.

items.headline: Scotia Global Asset Management Launches New Suite of Asset Allocation and Systematic ETFs
items.summary: Scotia Global Asset Management has introduced four new Scotia Asset Allocation ETFs and three Dynamic Systematic ETFs to its investment lineup.

items.headline: YYForce Announces Commencement of Optimus Humanoid Robot Manufacturing
items.summary: YYForce has publicly acknowledged and applauded Tesla's commencement of manufacturing for its Optimus humanoid robots.

items.headline: United Rentals Announces Pricing of Senior Notes Offering
items.summary: United Rentals, Inc. announced that its subsidiary, United Rentals (North America), Inc., has priced an offering of $2.5 billion in aggregate principal amount of senior notes.

items.headline: Indonesia Energy Corporation Commences Drilling at WK-5 Well

items.headline: Shoppers Drug Mart Releases Health Outcomes Report
items.summary: Loblaw subsidiary Shoppers Drug Mart published a report detailing the positive impact of its community pharmacy network on Canadian healthcare outcomes.

items.summary: Texas Instruments announced the pricing of $2.0 billion in senior unsecured notes to help fund its acquisition of Silicon Laboratories Inc.

items.headline: Waste Management Workers in Southern California Ratify New Teamsters Contract
items.summary: Approximately 700 Waste Management employees in Los Angeles and Orange counties, represented by Teamsters Local 396, have ratified a new collective bargaining agreement.

items.headline: Aflac Incorporated Announces 2026 Financial Analysts Briefing
items.summary: Aflac Incorporated announced it will host a webcast for its 2026 Financial Analysts Briefing on December 3, 2026.
